funnel.raw_definition: distinct employer-level candidates surfaced across current multi-query job-board searches after obvious cross-query duplicate removal; no vacancy-row inflation
funnel.notes: HH-heavy results were visibly saturated with previously seen employers and obvious rejects, so discovery was rotated to current Cataloxy, DreamJob, Nesiditsa, Facancy, JobVK/JobCareer and regional job-board mirrors. Exact duplicate-vs-early-reject counts were not separately instrumented and are intentionally not reconstructed. Deep checks included ARFA, GK Rosta, RS-Detal, UralAktiv, Germes-Sibir, Advanta-M Rostov, Ekaterinburgskiy Zavod Vysokovoltnogo Oborudovaniya and Vertro. Only the two fully evidenced candidates below are staged.
